mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which can potentiate cholinergic effects of galantamine and increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias and neuromuscular complications.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and cardiac rhythm during concurrent use; consider dose adjustment or alternative antifungal if possible.
